Expand

Random chance (based on step count) when accessing a PC

Collapse

The game keeps track of the total steps taken. If the player accesses a PC when the steps are divisible by 200, a Porygon will be added to the player's party (or first available PC storage space if the party is full). Afterwards the total steps counter will increase by 1 so the event can't be instantly repeated.
